description: Check a Krew Guru profile draft by its draft_token from create_seafarer_profile_draft: status (verification_sent or email_required), masked email, CV preview without contacts, handoff_url and matched_vacancies. Use this when the seafarer comes back later and asks about the draft or the matched vacancies. An unknown or expired token returns an error; then create a new draft. Do not use for signing in or for entering the email code: the seafarer does that on krew.guru.

draft_token.description: draft_token returned by create_seafarer_profile_draft (64 hex characters).

name: get_profile_draft_status
title: Get profile draft status
